label: Bible Study
prompt: Let all _____, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
verse: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
note: Paul's list of things to take out with the trash — six of them, starting with bitterness.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall _____:
verse: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
note: Amos's whole message in six words: Seek ye me, and ye shall live.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and _____. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
verse: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
note: Nehemiah's pep talk worked: the people answered, 'Let us rise up and build' — and the wall went up in 52 days.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall _____ for ever and ever.
verse: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
note: The seventh trumpet's announcement — Handel set these very words in the 'Hallelujah' chorus of Messiah.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one _____ in one place.
verse: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
note: When the day of Pentecost 'was fully come,' the disciples were all together 'with one accord' — of one mind.
